📰 General

Nvidia Stock Plummets Amidst Renewed Concerns and Analyst Downgrades •

Nvidia’s stock price experienced a significant decline following a report of renewed concerns regarding its artificial intelligence chip business. Several analysts have issued downgrades on the stock, citing slowing demand and increased competition in the AI sector. The company’s recent earnings report highlighted a decrease in gaming revenue, contributing to investor apprehension. This downturn marks a shift from the previous “Jensen Jubilation” surrounding Nvidia’s rapid growth.

🌍 World

Putin Accuses Ukraine of Attacks on Russian Oil Plants, Vows Retaliation •

Russian President Vladimir Putin stated that Ukraine continued its attacks on Russian oil refineries, despite a request from U.S. President Donald Trump to cease these operations. Putin asserted that Kyiv had disregarded the plea for restraint. He affirmed Russia’s intention to respond with retaliatory measures against Ukrainian targets. The attacks are reportedly targeting critical infrastructure within Russia’s energy sector.

🦅 US

GTA 6 Cloud Streaming Now Available on PS5 and PlayStation Portal •

Rockstar Games has expanded access to Grand Theft Auto 6 through cloud streaming. PlayStation Plus Premium subscribers who purchase the game can stream it directly to a PlayStation 5 console or the PlayStation Portal handheld. This allows players to experience the game without downloading the full title to their device. The streaming feature is available as part of the game’s purchase, offering a flexible gameplay option.

💰 Business

AMD and Broadcom Stocks Surge Following CEO Henrique Castruita’s Return •

Shares of Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) and Broadcom experienced a significant surge following the appointment of Henrique Castruita as CEO. Castruita previously served as AMD’s CEO from 2008 to 2014 and his return signals a renewed confidence in the company’s strategy. Investors reacted positively to the move, driving Broadcom’s stock to its highest level in over a year. Analysts believe Castruita’s experience could revitalize AMD’s competitive position in the semiconductor market.

💻 Technology

Wizards of the Coast Sues Website for Alleged $28 Million Magic: The Gathering Counterfeit Operation •

Wizards of the Coast has filed a lawsuit against PrintMTG, a website specializing in printing Magic: The Gathering proxies, alleging a large-scale counterfeiting operation. The lawsuit claims PrintMTG was producing and distributing unauthorized copies of the trading card game’s cards for commercial gain. Wizards of the Coast is seeking $28 million in damages, citing significant harm to their intellectual property and the integrity of the game. The legal action underscores the ongoing challenges of combating unauthorized reproductions within the popular trading card game market.

🎭 Entertainment

David Fincher Faces Scrutiny Over Potential AI Use in New Film •

Early screenings of David Fincher’s “Cliff Booth” have prompted concerns regarding the potential use of artificial intelligence in the film’s production. Interpositive, the company responsible for the film’s digital intermediate, reportedly utilized AI-powered tools for tasks such as rotoscoping and color correction. This has led to questions about the creative process and the extent of AI involvement in the film’s creation. Fincher’s studio, Integral Productions, has acknowledged the use of Interpositive’s technology but has not confirmed the specific extent of AI’s contribution.

🏅 Sports

Cubs Bolster Rotation with Significant Signing of Trevor Rogers •

The Chicago Cubs have initiated a rotation rebuild by acquiring right-handed pitcher Trevor Rogers from the New York Mets. The trade involves the Cubs sending a player to be named later and cash considerations. Rogers, who was recently optioned by the Mets, was a key member of the Cubs’ rotation in 2023, pitching 117.2 innings with a 4.28 ERA. This move aims to provide the Cubs with a fresh starting pitcher and bolster their pitching staff.

🔬 Science

BepiColombo Successfully Enters Mercury Orbit After Eight-Year Mission Delay •

The BepiColombo spacecraft has successfully achieved orbit around Mercury following an eight-year journey and a significant technical issue. The mission, a collaborative effort between the European Space Agency and the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency, encountered a glitch that threatened to halt its progress. Engineers were able to resolve the problem, allowing the spacecraft to continue its planned observations of the planet. The primary goal of the mission is to study Mercury’s environment and composition.

🩺 Health

Pennsylvania Reports Ninth Measles Death; Unvaccinated Resident Dies of Virus •

A Pennsylvania resident who had not been vaccinated against measles has died from the virus, marking the ninth fatality in the state this year. Pennsylvania health officials confirmed the death following a positive test result. The Department of Health attributed the deaths to the highly contagious and potentially deadly disease. This marks a significant increase in measles cases and deaths within the state, prompting renewed calls for vaccination.
